_readme: The judgement calls the SKU generator cannot make on its own.
Edit this file rather than the script: these are decisions about the
business's own naming, and they should be readable by whoever has to
live with them.
colours: a Shopify colour name on the left, the three-letter code on the
right. Several names may share a code where they are genuinely the same
colour - 'Mint' and 'Mint Green' are one colour written twice, and
'burgany' is a misspelling of Burgundy.
sizes: a Shopify size value on the left, the code on the right. Needed
where the value written on the product does not fit in four characters.
componentOptions: option names that name a part of a garment rather than
a variation of it. A vest is not a size of a set, it is a different
garment sold alongside one - so it belongs in the style code, and
TULIPVEST-BEI-M and TULIPPANTS-BEI-M are two styles rather than one with
a fourth dimension the SKU convention has no room for.
singleColour: products whose garment has one colourway that Shopify does
not record. Only fill one in when you know the answer - a guessed colour
is worse than a missing SKU, because it looks right.
styleCodes: a Shopify product title on the left, its style code on the
right. Only needed where two products would otherwise produce the same
code from their first word.
